question: Match the items in Column-I with the correct properties in Column-II.
In the following, <katex>$[x]$</katex> denotes the greatest integer less than or equal to <katex>$x$</katex>.

| Column - I | Column - II |
| :--- | :--- |
| (a) <katex>$x\lvert x\rvert$</katex> | (i) continuous in <katex>$(-1,1)$</katex> |
| (b) <katex>$\sqrt{x}$</katex> | (ii) differentiable in <katex>$(-1,1)$</katex> |
| (c) <katex>$x+[x]$</katex> | (iii) strictly increasing in <katex>$(-1,1)$</katex> |
| (d) <katex>$\lvert x-1\rvert+\lvert x+1\rvert$</katex> | (iv) not differentiable at, at least one point in <katex>$(-1,1)$</katex> |
explanation: (a) <katex>$x\lvert x\rvert$</katex> is <katex>$x^2$</katex> for <katex>$x>0$</katex>, <katex>$-x^2$</katex> for <katex>$x<0$</katex>. Differentiable everywhere. Matches (ii).
(b) <katex>$\sqrt{x}$</katex> has a vertical tangent at 0. Not differentiable at 0. Matches (iv).
(c) <katex>$x+[x]$</katex> increases as x increases. Strictly increasing. Matches (iii).
(d) <katex>$\lvert x-1\rvert+\lvert x+1\rvert$</katex> is constant 2 in <katex>$[-1,1]$</katex>. Continuous everywhere. Matches (i) (also differentiable in (-1,1)).
The best fit is option (3): a-ii, b-iv, c-iii, d-i.
